title: **Nikzad: US Strategic Calculations for Iran’s Swift, Low-Cost Surrender Have Failed**
text:
**Nikzad: US Strategic Calculations for Iran’s Swift, Low-Cost Surrender Have Failed**"

"At a ceremony commemorating Ayatollah Taleghani, the Deputy Speaker of Iran’s Parliament, Nikzad, said:"

"🔹 In designing its strategies against Iran, the United States made fundamental miscalculations and believed it could impose a swift, decisive and low-cost war through pressure, threats and military campaign, forcing the country to surrender."

"🔹 This approach shows that U.S. officials lack a deep understanding of Iran’s history, its real power and the components of the Iranian nation’s resilience."

"🔹 The nature of Iran’s confrontation and resistance to hegemonic behavior is rooted in religious teachings, the Ashura model and a culture of refusing humiliation."

"🔹 Reliance on the opposing side’s logistical and material tools has failed to shake national will, and on this basis, the scenario of short-term dominance over Iran has once again failed."

""
"**Nikzad: Western Intelligence Services Admit Miscalculation on Iran**"

"At the same ceremony, the Deputy Speaker of Iran’s Parliament also said:"

"🔹 Reports by foreign intelligence agencies, including MI6, show the West’s miscalculation in understanding the Islamic Republic of Iran’s defense power, security capabilities and popular support."

"🔹 The authority of the country’s armed forces is not based on weapons budgets, but on a spirit of sacrifice and round-the-clock readiness."

"🔹 Nuclear technology and the uranium enrichment cycle are an indigenous achievement that cannot be taken away, and efforts to protect it will continue resolutely."

"🔹 On the international stage, the transition away from a unipolar system has rendered sanctions ineffective, and the emergence of serious rifts between the United States and the Zionist regime is evidence of the decline of hegemonic power and the failure of enemy scenarios.
